text_en: To the leader. A Psalm of David.
Happy are those who consider the poor; the Lord delivers them in the day of trouble.
text_cn: 眷顾贫穷人的人，真是有福， 患难时日，他必蒙上主救助。

text_en: The Lord protects them and keeps them alive; they are called happy in the land. You do not give them up to the will of their enemies.
text_cn: 上主必保护他，赐他生存，在世上蒙福， 决不将他交给他的仇敌而任敌所欲。

text_en: The Lord sustains them on their sickbed; in their illness you heal all their infirmities.
text_cn: 他呻吟床榻，上主给他支援， 他患病时，必使他转危为安。

text_en: As for me, I said, “O Lord , be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against you. ”
text_cn: 我曾哀求你：“上主，求你怜悯我，” “求你治愈我，因为我得罪了你。”

text_en: My enemies wonder in malice when I will die, and my name perish.
text_cn: 我的仇敌反而恶言辱骂我说： “他何时死，他的名字几时泯灭？”

text_en: And when they come to see me, they utter empty words, while their hearts gather mischief; when they go out, they tell it abroad.
text_cn: 前来探访我的人，只以虚言相待， 其实是心怀恶意，出去便说出来。

text_en: All who hate me whisper together about me; they imagine the worst for me.
text_cn: 恨我的人，个个窃窃私议，咒我遭殃生疾：

text_en: They think that a deadly thing has fastened on me, that I will not rise again from where I lie.
text_cn: “愿他身患恶疾！ 愿他一病不起！”

text_en: Even my bosom friend in whom I trusted, who ate of my bread, has lifted the heel against me.
text_cn: 连我素来信赖的知心友好， 吃过我饭的人，也举脚踢我。

text_en: But you, O Lord , be gracious to me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
text_cn: 上主，求你可怜我，使我病除， 为使我能对他们加以复仇。

text_en: By this I know that you are pleased with me; because my enemy has not triumphed over me.
text_cn: 我以此作为你真爱我的记号： 就是不让我的敌人向我夸耀；

text_en: But you have upheld me because of my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
text_cn: 你时常保持我无灾无难， 使我永远站在你的面前。

text_en: Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
text_cn: 愿上主，以色列天主，受赞颂， 自永远直到永远，阿们，阿们！
